Aḍḍhakāsitherīgāthā Aḍḍhakāsi Verses of the Elder Aḍḍhakāsi

“Yāva kāsijanapado, The price for my services “In the country of Kāsi suṅko me tatthako ahu; amounted to the nation of Kāsi. I was purchased. Taṁ katvā negamo agghaṁ, By setting that price, The townsman set a price, aḍḍhenagghaṁ ṭhapesi maṁ. the townsfolk made me priceless. but settled for half of it.

Atha nibbindahaṁ rūpe, Then, growing disillusioned with my form, Then I was disenchanted by form; nibbindañca virajjahaṁ; I became dispassionate. disenchanted, I became dispassionate. Mā puna jātisaṁsāraṁ, Don’t journey on and on, May I not be reborn again in saṁsāra, sandhāveyyaṁ punappunaṁ; transmigrating through rebirths! may I not return again and again! Tisso vijjā sacchikatā, I’ve realized the three knowledges, Now I have realized the three knowledges kataṁ buddhassa sāsanan”ti. and fulfilled the Buddha’s instructions. and completed the teaching of the Buddha.”

… Aḍḍhakāsi therī …. The Elder Aḍḍhakāsi
